description: Create a draft order from the cart + address + promo and return {checkout_url, draft_id, expires_at}. The human opens checkout_url — everything is pre-filled — reviews and pays. The agent never pays. Call get_order_preview and confirm with the human first.
name: prepare_order

checkout_url.description: Pre-filled checkout link — send it to the human to review and pay.

error.description: Empty cart, missing address or no orderable items.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 time when the draft expires (48 h).

title: Prepare checkout
